cover.headline: [Marry] her if she has these [10] green flags

slides: 1. She loves cooking
She can cook and look after you, instead of always finding ways to be ungrateful to you.
2. She loves children
When a woman truly loves you, she wants your kids. If her dream is becoming a mother, she's the one.
3. She takes care of her appearance
A man is respected more next to a well-mannered, feminine woman who looks after herself. How she treats herself is how she'll treat you.
4. She doesn't have a male best friend
Women with close male friends cheat the most, because those friends want to sleep with her. Don't be fooled.
5. She loves her parents
If she doesn't treat her parents with love and respect, chances are she'll treat yours the same way.
6. She dresses modestly
If she dresses provocatively, she wants attention from random men. A high-value woman dresses like that only for her man.
7. She believes in God
Faith turns into a healthy marriage. Religion and God mean devotion and unconditional love.
8. She doesn't go clubbing
If she'd rather stay home and read than go clubbing, she's the one.
9. She keeps her home clean
A high-value woman takes care of her home. Enough said.
10. She doesn't drink or smoke
Smoking makes women less attractive, and most women who smoke smell of it.
closing: Save this before you choose her.
caption:
Marry her if she has these 10 green flags. Most men learn them too late.

She cooks and looks after you, wants a family, takes care of herself, loves her parents, dresses modestly, has faith, skips the clubs, keeps her home clean, and doesn't drink or smoke.

Which of these 10 matters most to you?
